thesis: The page is the sample inspection report Squarecount hands you: one drawn roof plan counts its squares facet by facet, and every section below is a numbered finding whose red-pen pin drops onto that plan and draws a leader to its evidence.

signature.name: Pinned Roof Plan
signature.summary: One SVG hip-roof plan drawing: facets outlined in blueprint blue, each fills with its squares in mono and a total tallies; red-pen numbered pins F-01 to F-07 mark findings. Hero holds the full plan; from 1024px a small copy docks in the margin and each finding section drops its pin, then a hairline leader draws from pin to the section photo, with a hand-drawn red circle around the verdict (FIX / WATCH / OK). Prices are pinned rows, reviews are signed-off pins with initials, the footer shows the plan complete with every pin ticked. Hook: data-sw-signature='pinned-plan'.

palette.family: Report White + Pencil Graphite + Red Pen + Blueprint Blue

motion.intro: Report sheet rises 40px from below like paper from a printer (520ms), then pins drop onto the plan with 60ms stagger and the facet counts tally to the total (900ms); total ≤ 1.2s, skipped by any scroll/key, static under reduced motion.
stories: Leader draw: as each finding enters, its pin drops on the margin plan and an SVG hairline draws (stroke-dashoffset) from pin to the section photo, then the red-pen circle draws around the verdict (verb: draw)
Square count: in the estimator, facets fill one by one and the mono total counts up as inputs change (verb: count)
motion.hover: Red-pen underline: a 2px red hairline grows scaleX(0→1) from the left under links, rows and cards, 200ms
